assets.prompt:
Pixel-art sticker icon for a cozy puzzle game, drawn on a strict 32x32 pixel grid and shown large with crisp hard-edged pixels (no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smoothing). Flat colors only: no gradients, no glossy highlights, no 3D, no photo. Palette: dark graphite #23262f for outlines and details, off-white paper #f6f3ec for light areas, one accent color, warm yellow #e0a800, plus a second accent, dark purple #2c2350, used only for the ink. A thick off-white #f6f3ec die-cut sticker border around the whole silhouette, risograph zine style. Plain flat #f6f3ec background (transparent if supported). One object, centered, filling about 80% of a square frame. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, frame, or drop shadow.

Subject: a chunky yellow kitchen sponge with soft rounded corners and a slightly squashed, pillowy outline, seen almost straight on, with only a thin side edge showing. Its face has many small irregular graphite pores of mixed sizes, mostly tiny, and no large round holes. A bold dark purple ink streak is being wiped across the yellow face, about a third of the sponge wide, with yellow showing all around it so it does not touch the graphite outline. Chunky and bold. Reads at a glance, even tiny, as: a sponge wiping up ink. It must not look like cheese, butter, or a box.

Production clarification: digital bitmap pixel-art game asset. Keep the named subject simple and chunky with hard square steps and flat solid palette colors. One centered object, no scenery, decorative symbols, colored backing disc, paper grain, texture, material lighting, grey shading, blur, gradients or drop shadow. The thick paper-colored border closely follows the actual silhouette; keep it complete and clear of all frame edges. Fully transparent outer background. Large square PNG, 1024x1024 or larger.
Candidate 3. Use this REWRITTEN subject description: soft pillowy near-frontal shape, only a thin side edge, MANY SMALL IRREGULAR PORES with no large round holes, and a BOLD dark purple ink STREAK about one third of the sponge wide fully surrounded by yellow, separated from the graphite outline. Preserve this readable ink streak at 18px; it must not shrink to a tiny edge dot. Use a gently squashed rounded rectangular silhouette.
assets.review_note: Rewritten pillowy near-frontal sponge, fine irregular pores, and a bold interior ink streak surrounded by yellow.
